pilot_E0.tau_q_rule: median over branches of best-so-far valid q at budget end (B_e(B_ep)); branches with zero valid nodes excluded from median but counted in report; <3 valid branches => tau undefined, Phase-5 threshold comparison inadmissible (descriptive only). Attainability: E0 itself attains tau on >=half its branches by construction of best-so-far + median.

replay_support.pilot_screen: episodes = 6 E0 branches; adequacy per rho with w>0: common eligible >=4 AND >=50% of 6; else inadmissible screen -> fresh fallback (SPEC pre-listed order)
replay_support.cycle_screen: episodes = all branches in frozen worlds listed in cycle SPEC; adequacy >=6 AND >=50% per rho
replay_support.phase5: NO replay screen; fresh rollouts only on 9 task panels (3 scopes x 3 adjustments; panel242 excluded from primary panels, sensitivity only) x 4 seeds x B_ep=4 nodes
